events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her unmistakable voice and rock 'n' roll attitude have given us decades of incredible music with The Pretenders. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his iconic swagger and vocals are still pure rock 'n' roll. What's your top Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single released (UK)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Single Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' single was released in the UK. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple launched its revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped a game-changer that put thousands of songs in our pockets. How did the iPod change your music habits?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen with 'Dr. No'. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated comedian and actor, John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique humour has given us so many unforgettable moments. What's your favourite John Cleese sketch or character?

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that showed every facet of the Fab Four. What's your standout track from this double LP?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Death
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost Freddie Mercury. His incredible voice and electrifying stage presence are truly missed. What's your favourite Freddie performance or Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal shift in their sound. This album truly changed the game for pop music. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's Death
events.blurb: The world tragically lost music icon John Lennon on this day in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, we lost a true visionary, John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?
